# Reuters
> Reuters is a global news organization covering breaking news, business, markets, politics, technology, and multimedia journalism worldwide.

Reuters publishes real-time reporting, analysis, explainers, graphics, video, and live coverage across international news, financial markets, and sector-specific topics. Its site includes topic hubs, special reports, fact checks, newsletters, and professional products for legal, tax, accounting, and risk audiences.

## Top News
- [World](https://www.reuters.com/world/): International news coverage spanning conflicts, diplomacy, disasters, and major global developments.
- [Business](https://www.reuters.com/business/): Business reporting on companies, industries, deals, and the global economy.
- [Markets](https://www.reuters.com/markets/): Financial markets news covering stocks, bonds, currencies, commodities, and investing.
- [Breakingviews](https://www.reuters.com/breakingviews/): Reuters commentary and analysis on business, finance, and economic events.
- [Investigations](https://www.reuters.com/investigates/): Deep investigative reporting and special projects from Reuters journalists.
- [Fact Check](https://www.reuters.com/fact-check/): Verified reporting that examines viral claims, misinformation, and manipulated content.

## World News
- [Africa](https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/): News and analysis on politics, security, and economies across Africa.
- [Americas](https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/): Coverage of North America, Latin America, and regional political developments.
- [Asia Pacific](https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/): Reporting on major events, economies, and geopolitics across Asia-Pacific.
- [China](https://www.reuters.com/world/china/): Dedicated coverage of Chinese politics, economy, diplomacy, and society.
- [Europe](https://www.reuters.com/world/europe/): European politics, policy, business, and cross-border developments.
- [India](https://www.reuters.com/world/india/): News on Indian politics, business, regulation, and current affairs.
- [Middle East](https://www.reuters.com/world/middle-east/): Reporting on regional conflicts, diplomacy, energy, and political change.
- [United Kingdom](https://www.reuters.com/world/uk/): UK-focused coverage of politics, economy, regulation, and society.

## U.S. News and Politics
- [Legal Government](https://www.reuters.com/legal/government/): Legal and regulatory reporting focused on government policy and public institutions.
- [United States](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/): National U.S. news covering politics, policy, courts, and major events.
- [U.S. Politics](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/politics/): Coverage of elections, Congress, the White House, and campaign developments.
- [Supreme Court](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/supreme-court/): Reporting on U.S. Supreme Court cases, rulings, and legal implications.
- [Congress](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/congress/): News on legislation, lawmakers, negotiations, and federal policymaking.
- [Elections](https://www.reuters.com/world/us/elections/): Election coverage, campaign updates, polling, and voting-related developments.

## Business and Finance
- [Deals](https://www.reuters.com/markets/deals/): Mergers, acquisitions, IPOs, and corporate transaction reporting.
- [Wealth](https://www.reuters.com/markets/wealth/): Personal finance, investing, retirement, and wealth management coverage.
- [Funds](https://www.reuters.com/markets/funds/): Reporting on mutual funds, ETFs, asset managers, and fund flows.
- [Rates & Bonds](https://www.reuters.com/markets/rates-bonds/): News on sovereign debt, yields, central banks, and bond markets.
- [Currencies](https://www.reuters.com/markets/currencies/): Foreign exchange reporting on major currencies and macro drivers.
- [Commodities](https://www.reuters.com/markets/commodities/): Coverage of oil, metals, agriculture, and commodity market trends.
- [Sustainable Business](https://www.reuters.com/sustainability/): Reporting on ESG, climate, energy transition, and corporate sustainability.

## Industry Coverage
- [Aerospace & Defense](https://www.reuters.com/business/aerospace-defense/): News on aviation, defense contractors, military procurement, and aerospace manufacturing.
- [Autos & Transportation](https://www.reuters.com/business/autos-transportation/): Coverage of automakers, EVs, logistics, airlines, and transportation policy.
- [Energy](https://www.reuters.com/business/energy/): Reporting on oil, gas, power, renewables, and energy markets.
- [Environment](https://www.reuters.com/business/environment/): News on climate policy, emissions, conservation, and environmental regulation.
- [Finance](https://www.reuters.com/business/finance/): Banking, insurance, asset management, and financial services coverage.
- [Healthcare & Pharma](https://www.reuters.com/business/healthcare-pharmaceuticals/): Reporting on drugmakers, medical research, regulation, and healthcare companies.
- [Media & Telecom](https://www.reuters.com/business/media-telecom/): News on media companies, streaming, telecom operators, and communications policy.
- [Retail & Consumer](https://www.reuters.com/business/retail-consumer/): Coverage of retailers, brands, consumer demand, and supply chains.
- [Technology](https://www.reuters.com/technology/): Reporting on major tech companies, AI, cybersecurity, and digital policy.

## Legal and Professional
- [Legal](https://www.reuters.com/legal/): Reuters legal news, analysis, and professional industry coverage.
- [Litigation](https://www.reuters.com/legal/litigation/): Reporting on major lawsuits, court disputes, and litigation trends.
- [Transactional](https://www.reuters.com/legal/transactional/): Coverage of dealmaking, corporate law, and transactional practice developments.
- [Legal Industry](https://www.reuters.com/legal/legalindustry/): News on law firms, legal business, talent, and professional services.
- [Tax & Accounting](https://www.reuters.com/legal/tax-accounting/): Reporting on tax policy, accounting standards, and compliance developments.
- [Risk & Compliance](https://www.reuters.com/legal/risk-compliance/): Coverage of regulation, enforcement, sanctions, and compliance management.

## Lifestyle and Culture
- [Lifestyle](https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/): Lifestyle reporting on entertainment, travel, sports, and human-interest stories.
- [Entertainment & Arts](https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/entertainment/): News on film, television, music, celebrities, and the arts.
- [Oddly Enough](https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/oddly-enough/): Unusual, quirky, and offbeat stories from around the world.
- [Travel](https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/travel/): Travel news, destination trends, and tourism industry developments.
- [Sports](https://www.reuters.com/lifestyle/sports/): Sports news, events, athletes, and competition coverage.

## Multimedia and Special Formats
- [Pictures](https://www.reuters.com/pictures/): Photojournalism galleries covering news, sports, entertainment, and global events.
- [Graphics](https://www.reuters.com/graphics/): Visual stories, data graphics, and interactive explanatory journalism.
- [Video](https://www.reuters.com/video/): Reuters video reports, interviews, clips, and live news footage.
- [Live](https://www.reuters.com/world/live/): Live blogs and rolling coverage of major breaking news events.
- [Special Reports](https://www.reuters.com/investigates/special-report/): Long-form special reports and in-depth investigative projects.
- [The Wider Image](https://www.reuters.com/world/the-wider-image/): Visual storytelling featuring photo essays and documentary-style reporting.

## Opinion, Analysis, and Newsletters
- [Breakingviews](https://www.reuters.com/breakingviews/): Sharp financial commentary and agenda-setting analysis from Reuters columnists.
- [Analysis](https://www.reuters.com/world/analysis/): Reported analysis that adds context and implications to major news events.
- [Explainers](https://www.reuters.com/world/explainers/): Background pieces clarifying complex issues, policies, and current events.
- [The Morning News](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/): Reuters newsletters page with editorial email products and sign-up options.
- [Reuters Daily Briefing](https://www.reuters.com/newsletters/): Newsletter hub for daily briefings, topic updates, and curated reporting.

## About Reuters
- [About Reuters](https://www.reuters.com/about-us/): Overview of Reuters, its mission, history, and editorial role.
- [Trust Principles](https://www.reuters.com/about-us/trust-principles/): Reuters standards for integrity, independence, and freedom from bias.
- [Editorial Handbook](https://www.reuters.com/about-us/editorial-handbook/): Guidance on Reuters editorial standards, sourcing, and newsroom practices.
- [Diversity Report](https://www.reuters.com/about-us/diversity-report/): Information on newsroom diversity, inclusion, and workforce representation.
- [Careers](https://www.reuters.com/careers/): Careers information for Reuters journalism, technology, and business roles.
- [Contact Us](https://www.reuters.com/info-pages/contact-us/): Contact information for Reuters products, services, and general inquiries.
